notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Donkey Kong Bananza" at completion stage 0. Only 4 subpages exist: "Walkthrough" (about 1,200 characters), "Bananzas" (about 2,000), "Controls" (about 2,800) and "Table of Contents" (about 1,500). The contents page lists the layers in this order: Ingot Isle Cave-in, Lagoon, Hilltop, Canyon, The Divide, Freezer, Forest, The Junction, Resort, Tempest, Landfill, Racing, Radiance, Groove, Feast, Forbidden, Planet Core and New Donk City, then Clothing and DK Artist; none of the layer pages is written, so only their names and order were used, and the grouping into chapters is a guess. Whether New Donk City is part of the main story or extra content was not checked. donkeykong.fandom.com answers the API, with about 80 linked pages, including the layer names, "Banandium Gem", "Elders", "VoidCo" and "Pauline"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists no developer or publisher and gives Nintendo Switch as the platform; StrategyWiki's page summary calls it a 3D platformer published by Nintendo for Nintendo Switch 2 and files it under "Nintendo Switch 2". No Steam app (steam=None).
